name: Weather Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *If there is a weather condition on the field, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. This Move's type will change according to the Weather. Sun/Fire, Rain/Water, Hail or Snow/Ice, Sand/Rock, Wind/Flying.
description: A ball created out of the forces of the weather. Today’s forecast is cloudy with a chance of pain!
